findings.finding: 'names this issue' has two live readings in the repository (key alone vs KEY: title); the plan must pin line 1's bytes and check them by byte comparison, not a grep for the key
findings.answer: Plan §1 pins line 1 to `LEGSMOKE-828: Pre-merge boot of a deployment's worker pod block` + LF (64 bytes), names repository precedent (every smoke/LEGSMOKE-*.md since LEGSMOKE-439, newest LEGSMOKE-817) as the source, and criterion 2 checks it with cmp against the literal plus wc -c/wc -l/od.

findings.finding: Dropping the title's (/tmp/...) run-directory suffix is an unsupported claim: no marker on main contains /tmp/ and no precedent title with a suffix was shown
findings.answer: Measured: issue LEGSMOKE-817's title carries ` (/tmp/legion-e2e4b.1893747.BXwB3mci)` and its marker on main (smoke/LEGSMOKE-817.md, merged in #701) holds `LEGSMOKE-817: Stage 4b proof tree 1: the whole workflow` without it. Plan §1 and M6 record that precedent as the rule's source.

findings.finding: The apostrophe in the title is a byte-level fork (U+0027 vs U+2019) no precedent settles
findings.answer: Measured with od -c on the Dispatch title: 0x27. Plan §1 pins ASCII U+0027, gives the printf splice literal, and the tester's near-miss list includes the U+2019 variant (66 bytes, measured).

findings.finding: The spec has no Acceptance section and v1 is approved, so criteria cannot be added to it without closing the design gate
findings.answer: Plan §4 derives five machine-checkable criteria from Summary and Scope; §9 states the approved spec is left untouched and whether it should carry an Acceptance section is the architect's call. plan.json carries the same five criteria.

findings.finding: 'Nothing else changes' is false for the branch mid-run (handoff JSON under .legion/); the plan must say at which artifact it is judged
findings.answer: Criterion 4 judges it on the head that merges and the merge commit (exactly `added smoke/LEGSMOKE-828.md`), names handoff JSON as the workflow's process record removed by retro, and gives the mid-run filter that admits only the marker and .legion/LEGSMOKE-828/ paths.

findings.finding: Whether retro may add a docs/solutions/ file is unsettled and changes the merged diff
findings.answer: Plan §7 decides: no docs/solutions document for this issue, because the spec's 'Nothing else changes' makes the merge commit one added file, skill://legion-retro allows a retro that commits no learning, the repository has no docs/ directory (404 measured), and LEGSMOKE-817's retro wrote none (its retro message, measured). A learning worth a document is a report to the architect.

findings.finding: The second-line arm has no stated detection rule, yet implementer, tester and reviewer must agree on it
findings.answer: Plan §3 gives one predicate K (top-level comment by trajectory-s-legion-reviewer[bot] on the file containing the literal `Legion proof review round 1 (LEGSMOKE)`), the exact second-line bytes, both byte targets (64/103), and the reviewer's REQUEST_CHANGES comment body in §6.2 embeds the literal verbatim; its shape is what PR #701 shows (measured).

findings.finding: 'Which head' is undefined for every proof line, and handoff-only pushes run no CI, so 'green at the merged head' needs the CI-head-plus-compare reading
findings.answer: Plan §2 head table: every proof[].headSha of a round names the newest code head (C1, then C1′), the tester re-runs at the then-current head with the compare, the reviewer approves C4 by SHA, a review-line push resets all three, and C5 (retro's removal) is a code push with its own runs.

findings.finding: Which checks must be green, at which SHA, is asserted but not pinned
findings.answer: Measured ruleset: one required context `gate`. Plan §2 and criterion 5 name `gate` required, `check` informational-but-expected, and the one deciding command: check-runs at CI_HEAD plus the compare to $S.

findings.finding: The production-like surface and its negative control are unnamed for a Markdown marker
findings.answer: Plan §4: GitHub contents API at a SHA with the raw media type, cmp against the literal; negative controls `?ref=main` -> 404 before the merge (measured today), `?ref=$BASE` -> 404 after, plus the near-miss cmps.

findings.finding: The post-merge production check needs a definition of 'production' for this repository
findings.answer: Plan §8: production is main on GitHub (the merge is the publish step; nothing deploys), with the exact post-merge commands and expected values (merged: true, ?ref=main 200, arm-selected cmp, merge-commit file list, runs success, $BASE 404) and the Production: line's wording.

findings.finding: A docs-only PR changes the required PR-body shape (Thermo omitted) and the literal Dispatch token must be checked
findings.answer: Plan §5.5: body line 1 `Dispatch: LEGSMOKE-828` checked with grep -c on the live body, template lines named, Thermo omitted, both E2E lines required before approval (§6.2).

findings.finding: Red CI / a stray .fail-me has no contingency and the only required check keys on it
findings.answer: Plan §6.4: .fail-me is outside scope; at a red head read contents/.fail-me and the commit's author first; present -> one deletion-only cure commit by the implementer (the #701 precedent, measured); absent -> gh run rerun --failed; outside author -> deviations[] and a report to the architect; a red above the approved head -> the architect decides.

findings.finding: The child LEGSMOKE-829's relation needs one explicit boundary line
findings.answer: Plan §13: this plan creates no smoke/LEGSMOKE-829.md, touches only legion/LEGSMOKE-828, makes 829 no dependency, and criterion 4's reads name only our file; whether READY or sign-off waits on 829 is the daemon's child rule and the architect's decision.

findings.finding: No document in the repository records the marker convention, so the plan is its only source
findings.answer: Plan §1 and plan.json `change` carry the full byte specification (file, line 1, shell literal, apostrophe, byte counts, review line, commit messages, PR title) so the implementer and tester need nothing else.
